title: Shortcode Templates: Write Your Own Shortcodes With Liquid | Orchard Core
description:
A shortcode in the body of a content item is normally code that a module registers, so a small piece of reusable markup becomes a development task.

The Shortcode Templates feature of Orchard Core moves that work to the admin: you write the shortcode as a Liquid template that receives the arguments, the inner content and the context of the caller.

In this video:
• What a shortcode template is, and the three values it receives
• Enabling the feature under Tools, Features
• Creating the primary template under Design, Shortcodes
• Using the template from the shortcode picker of the editor
• Reading the content item, replacing a shortcode from code, and rendering shortcodes in your own views
• Moving templates with recipes and deployment plans, and the permission that guards them
